caption:
-16%: the H100 1-year contract median ($3.26) against its on-demand median ($3.90) per GPU-hour.

The gap is wider elsewhere: MI355X $4.25 vs $7.00, MI300X $1.91 vs $2.99. It is narrow on A100: $1.59 vs $1.75.

The context: LTN Compute is deploying NVIDIA B300 GPUs at its Chennai data center under a multi-year engagement; DCD's headline puts the cluster at 10,000 GPUs. India has 2,622 MW under construction in our pipeline.

Data: Coloprice GPU index, 16 Nov 2026; Coloprice pipeline tracker, 24 Nov 2026. Sources on the last slide.
